gen-gf-unkempt-gf-istok-web: Unkempt weights its diagonals just like its verticals, so the heading looks blunt and commanding, grabbing the eye before anything else. Istok Web, a friendly sans-serif, stays low-key underneath and lets it talk.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-jura: Loud and commanding, Unkempt takes the top. Jura sits below in constant, bent-wire strokes with wide-open s curves, so the heading does the shouting and the text just talks.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-k2d: Expressive and commanding right away, Unkempt keeps its t crossbar and stem matched in weight, so the heading looks deliberate. K2D, a sans-serif with tube-like strokes, keeps the text smooth beneath.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-line-seed-jp: LINE Seed JP gives horizontals and verticals the same heft, so text stays easy going. LINE Seed JP's open counters let the eye slip through, leaving Unkempt to do the shouting above.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-lxgw-marker-gothic: LXGW Marker Gothic reads smoothly, its wide-open c and gentle weight shifts barely noticeable until you look closely at the text. Unkempt's ruler-drawn line leaves the text feeling quiet by comparison.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-m-plus-1p: Unkempt pushes expressive, commanding letters with no swelling where curves meet stems, giving the heading a blunt presence. M PLUS 1p keeps every curve end open, so text moves along easily.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-m-plus-2: M PLUS 2 reads friendly and open, with a gaping c and one fixed nib width throughout. While Unkempt makes a statement with its matched t crossbar and stem, the body simply carries the words.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: M PLUS Rounded 1c reads gently, its terminals stopping short of curling back in, which keeps the text approachable. Unkempt's pen-like line of constant weight supplies the bite up top.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-mina: Unkempt brings expressive, commanding letters, its t crossbar and stem matched in weight, to the heading. Mina, a sans with stitched-thread strokes and open small curves, handles the text quietly.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-monda: Loud and commanding, Unkempt draws an o whose sides and top are all equally thick. And Monda, a sans-serif with unclogged small counters, keeps the reading easy over many lines.
